copy.comparison_rule: Original word spaces preserved; the single line break at a word boundary is explicitly allowed. Exact observed syllables are 숨과 / 숨 사이.

mandatory_conditions.required: 검은 글자와 흰 단색 배경만 사용한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Letters are black and background looks white; a faint fine grain remains across the native white field and within black strokes, so it is not visually a flat solid surface.

mandatory_conditions.required: 원문 한 문자열을 각 이미지에 정확히 한 번 표시한다. 원문에 있는 두 번의 '숨'을 임의 중복으로 오판하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: The complete phrase appears once, as upper-left 숨과 followed by lower-right 숨 사이; both required 숨 syllables are present.
No illustration, icon, shape, border, rule, decorative character or additional copy. Faint granular/diagonal texture is visible, which violates the explicit texture ban.

mandatory_conditions.required: 어절을 보존하고 어절 사이 줄바꿈만 허용한다. 글자 내부 구조를 장식 그림으로 해체하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Only one line break, after 숨과. All five Hangul syllables remain intact and readable.

mandatory_conditions.required: 사용자가 비율을 지정하지 않았으므로 다섯 장 모두 세로 2:3으로 만든다.

typography.location: Upper-left text group and lower-right text group
typography.observed: Heavy upright Korean sans forms with open counters. Glyphs and word grouping read correctly at 720 and 320. Same apparent height across both groups; no clipping, overlap or deconstructed character strokes.

space.location: Broad center interval between first and second groups
space.observed: The two equal-weight semantic groups step from upper-left to lower-right with a conspicuous unmarked white pause. The lower group has a tighter right margin than the first left margin but both remain clear of the edges.

material.location: Native white field from top-left to bottom-right and broad black glyph strokes
material.observed: The very faint diagonal/granular pattern remains visible after the edit. It is less conspicuous at 720 and effectively absent at 320, but remains a native-size no-texture defect.

ai_slop.location: Native flat field and glyph interiors
ai_slop.observed: Unrequested subtle grain persists. No added symbols, microcopy, new image or new finishing effects appeared.

uncertainties.observed: No claim of every pixel being exactly RGB 255/0 is made; observation is visual. The visible grain is sufficient reason for a targeted surface correction.

correction_decision.reason: First surface-only edit did not remove the visible native pattern. Redraw the same two-block typography as explicitly pure white/pure black digital surfaces; preserve phrase and pause.
